edges.notes: uClibc implements the C standard library for Linux userland on supported architectures.
uClibc provides syscall wrappers and POSIX-oriented services on Linux.
Typical uClibc deployments use ELF shared objects and the uClibc dynamic linker on Linux.
GCC cross toolchains commonly target uClibc sysroots in embedded Linux builds.
GNU ld links uClibc objects and shared libraries in embedded GNU/Linux flows.
Clang may target uClibc sysroots when embedded distributions provide matching triplets.
Embedded Linux ports may combine uClibc with RISC-V Linux targets where supported.
g++ may link GNU libstdc++ above uClibc in embedded Linux toolchains when configured.
Clang libc++ stacks may target uClibc-backed sysroots in specialized embedded flows.
libc++abi may pair with libc++ on uClibc when packaging matches.
